month_notes: November is the heart of Da Nang's storm-and-flood season, and the first full month running entirely on the winter schedule. Singapore Airlines now lands three times a day instead of two and Vietnam Airlines twice from Bangkok, while Air Cambodia's Siem Reap flight has moved from late afternoon to 20:00 on a 180-seat jet instead of a 72-seat turboprop. VietJet has cut Seoul to four flights a week until 5 December, and it is Asiana's last full month before its 17 December merger into Korean Air.
empty_band_note: Two Korean red-eyes clear the hall after midnight

context.text: Da Nang International Airport handled 13.1 million passengers in the first nine months of 2026, and the winter schedule adds more: Singapore Airlines alone lifts Da Nang from 2,156 to 3,234 seats a week from 25 October.

basis: based on flight schedules and queue times reported at the airport in 2025–2026
